newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens invests NLG 300 mln in environment.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens invests NLG 300 mln in environment.

text.p: Hoogovens NV said on Tuesday it planned to invest 300 million guilders in various environmental measures from 1997 to 2000.
The steel and aluminium group said the measures would enable it to meet or exceed most of the reductions in pollution agreed by the Dutch government and the metals industry.
However, Hoogovens said that despite the planned measures it would have problems in achieving the targeted reductions for sulphur dioxide and nitrous oxides.
Hoogovens said measures costing 100 million guilders would be implemented from 1997 to 2000 under its 1992 company environment plan BMP-1.
Additional measures costing some 200 million guilders would be implemented under a second plan, BMP-2, which has been submitted in draft form to regulatory authorities.
The authorities are due to respond to the draft plan by January 1, 1997, with Hoogovens submitting a final version by March 1 for government approval in April.
